mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MOVIE (MOVIE_ID, TITLE, FIRST_RELEASE_DATE, SCREENING_START_DATE, SCREENING_END_DATE, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (MOVIE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{firstReleaseDate}, #{screeningStartDate}, #{screeningEndDate}, #{regId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID AS "movieId", TITLE AS "title", FIRST_RELEASE_DATE AS "firstReleaseDate", SCREENING_START_DATE AS "screeningStartDate", SCREENING_END_DATE AS "screeningEndDate", REG_ID AS "regId", REG_DT AS "regDt", MOD_ID AS "modId", MOD_DT AS "modDt" FROM MOVIE ORDER BY REG_DT DESC, MOVIE_ID DESC

SELECT MOVIE_ID AS "movieId", TITLE AS "title", FIRST_RELEASE_DATE AS "firstReleaseDate", SCREENING_START_DATE AS "screeningStartDate", SCREENING_END_DATE AS "screeningEndDate", REG_ID AS "regId", REG_DT AS "regDt", MOD_ID AS "modId", MOD_DT AS "modDt" FROM MOVIE WHERE MOVIE_ID = #{movieId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MOVIE SET TITLE = #{title}, FIRST_RELEASE_DATE = #{firstReleaseDate}, SCREENING_START_DATE = #{screeningStartDate}, SCREENING_END_DATE = #{screeningEndDate}, MOD_ID = #{modId}, MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MOVIE_ID = #{movieId}
